Study equipment and machine manuals thoroughly to understand operational guidelines and maintenance requirements.

Develop and document maintenance cycles for each piece of equipment by recording maintenance schedules. And ensure that drawings and technical information accurately reflect the current status of equipment.
Analyze process cycles to confirm that equipment operates according to specified parameters.
Collaborate with production teams to schedule maintenance activities, aiming to minimize breakdowns, leakages, and failures.

pcs.pc_description: Execute scheduled maintenance and unscheduled repairs following manufacturers' instructions.
Address daily equipment breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime.
Optimize machinery operations to ensure peak performance.
Inspect internal components, such as wiring and motherboards, to verify proper functionality.
Discuss any unusual equipment issues with operators to identify potential problems.
Monitor for defective materials and equipment malfunctions during operations.
Maintain regular cleaning and sanitation of all equipment and facilities.

Improve, debug, and optimize equipment setups and changeovers to enhance efficiency.
Maintain online documentation for daily maintenance activities.
Document all maintenance activities, including regular upkeep, replacements, preventive measures, breakdown logs, repairs, testing, and machine history.
Ensure 100% completion of scheduled maintenance procedures.
Meet target specifications within established schedules.
Maintain a dust-free environment in compliance with company policies.
